tools.name: generate_form_transaction
tools.description: Constructs a ready-to-sign on-chain EVM transaction (to, data, value, chainId) for the FormFactory smart contract (createForm, closeForm, activateForm, archiveForm, updateSchemaHash) with exact 0.00005 ETH protocol fee (0x2d79883d2000).

tools.name: confirm_form
tools.description: Registers and indexes an on-chain created form in the IFORM registry with its questions schema and transaction hash, generating the 6-character short slug (e.g. /e3qa69) and live URL.

tools.name: query_forms
tools.description: Queries decentralized forms by chain ID, creator wallet address, or status (active, closed, archived).

tools.name: get_form_responses
tools.description: Fetches submitted responses for a specific decentralized form by form ID or slug.
